# VOTA-studios
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="de">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>VOTA STUDIOS — Fotostudio</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Unbounded:wght@400;500;600;700;800;900&family=Archivo:wght@400;500;600;700;800&family=Space+Mono:wght@400;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
  :root{
    --logo-url:url("data:image/png;base64,");
    --ink:#0b0b0b;
    --cream:#fff7d2;
    --tape:#c73e3e;
    --ink-soft:#1c1c1c;
    --cream-soft:#f2e9bd;
    --gray:#8a8a82;
    --serif-line: 1.15;
  }
  *{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box;}
  html{scroll-behavior:smooth;}
  body{
    font-family:'Archivo', sans-serif;
    background:var(--cream);
    color:var(--ink);
    overflow-x:hidden;
    -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;
  }
  a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none;}
  button{font-family:inherit;cursor:pointer;border:none;background:none;color:inherit;}
  ul{list-style:none;}
  img{max-width:100%;display:block;}

  .page{display:none;}
  .page.active{display:block;}

  /* ============ SHARED NAV (all pages except home) ============ */
  .site-nav{
    position:sticky; top:0; z-index:200;
    display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between;
    padding:22px 40px;
    background:inherit;
    border-bottom:1px solid rgba(11,11,11,0.12);
  }
  .theme-dark .site-nav{border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,247,210,0.15);}
  .site-nav .nav-links{display:flex; gap:34px; align-items:center;}
  .site-nav .nav-links a{
    font-size:14px; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:0.01em;
    position:relative; padding-bottom:3px;
  }
  .site-nav .nav-links a::after{
    content:""; position:absolute; left:0; bottom:0; width:0; height:1.5px;
    background:var(--tape); transition:width .25s ease;
  }
  .site-nav .nav-links a:hover::after, .site-nav .nav-links a.current::after{width:100%;}
  .nav-mark{
    width:34px; height:34px; flex-shrink:0; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
    transition:transform .25s ease, background-color .2s ease;
    background-color:var(--ink);
    -webkit-mask-image:var(--logo-url); mask-image:var(--logo-url);
    -webkit-mask-size:contain; mask-size:contain;
    -webkit-mask-repeat:no-repeat; mask-repeat:no-repeat;
    -webkit-mask-position:center; mask-position:center;
  }
  .theme-dark .nav-mark{background-color:var(--cream);}
  .nav-mark:hover{transform:scale(1.08);}
  .nav-half{display:flex; gap:34px; align-items:center; flex:1;}
  .nav-half.right{justify-content:flex-end;}
  .nav-burger{display:none;}

  @media (max-width:820px){
    .site-nav{padding:16px 20px;}
    .nav-half{display:none;}
    .nav-burger{display:block; font-size:13px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:.04em;}
    .site-nav.menu-open .nav-half{
      display:flex; position:absolute; top:100%; left:0; right:0;
      flex-direction:column; align-items:flex-start; gap:0; padding:10px 20px 22px;
      background:var(--cream);
    }
    .theme-dark .site-nav.menu-open .nav-half{background:var(--ink);}
    .site-nav.menu-open .nav-half a{padding:10px 0; width:100%; border-bottom:1px solid rgba(11,11,11,.08);}
  }

  /* ============ HOME / HERO ============ */
  #home{background:var(--ink); color:var(--cream); min-height:100vh; position:relative;}
  .hero-nav{
    display:flex; align-items:center;
    padding:26px 40px; position:relative; z-index:20;
  }
  .hero-nav-side{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:32px; flex:1;}
  .hero-nav-side.left{justify-content:flex-start;}
  .hero-nav-side.right{justify-content:flex-end;}
  .hero-wordmark{font-family:'Unbounded',sans-serif; font-weight:700; font-size:14px; letter-spacing:.02em;}
  .hero-nav .nav-links{display:flex; gap:32px; align-items:center;}
  .hero-nav .nav-links a{font-size:13.5px; font-weight:600;}
  .hero-nav .nav-links a::after{content:""; display:block; width:0; height:1.5px; background:var(--tape); transition:width .25s ease;}
  .hero-nav .nav-links a:hover::after{width:100%;}
  .hero-mark{
    width:32px;height:32px; flex-shrink:0; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; transition:transform .25s ease;
    background-color:var(--cream);
    -webkit-mask-image:var(--logo-url); mask-image:var(--logo-url);
    -webkit-mask-size:contain; mask-size:contain;
    -webkit-mask-repeat:no-repeat; mask-repeat:no-repeat;
    -webkit-mask-position:center; mask-position:center;
  }
  @media (max-width:820px){.hero-nav-side{gap:18px;} .hero-wordmark{font-size:12px;}}
  .hero-mark:hover{transform:scale(1.08);}

  .hero-stage{
    position:relative;
    height:calc(100vh - 84px);
    display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
    padding:0 24px 100px;
  }
  .hero-copy{
    position:absolute; top:8%; left:6%; max-width:280px;
    font-size:14px; line-height:1.5; color:var(--cream-soft);
  }
  .hero-copy.right{left:auto; right:6%; text-align:right;}
  .hero-copy b{color:var(--cream); font-weight:700;}

  .hero-frame-wrap{
    position:relative; width:min(72vw,560px); height:min(58vh,460px);
    display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
  }
  .hero-frame{
    position:absolute; border-radius:22px; overflow:hidden;
    background:#111; box-shadow:0 30px 80px rgba(0,0,0,.55);
    transition:transform .6s cubic-bezier(.22,.8,.28,1), opacity .6s ease, filter .6s ease;
  }
  .hero-frame img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;}
  .hero-frame.f-main{width:62%; height:100%; z-index:3;}
  .hero-frame.f-left{width:46%; height:82%; left:-6%; z-index:2; filter:brightness(.55);}
  .hero-frame.f-right{width:46%; height:82%; right:-6%; z-index:2; filter:brightness(.55);}

  .hero-meta{
    position:absolute; bottom:190px; left:0; right:0;
    display:flex; justify-content:space-between; padding:0 8%;
    font-family:'Space Mono', monospace; font-size:12px; color:var(--gray); letter-spacing:.02em;
  }

  /* ---- Maßband job switcher ---- */
  .tape-wrap{
    position:absolute; bottom:0; left:0; right:0;
    padding:26px 0 30px;
    background:linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(11,11,11,0), rgba(11,11,11,.9) 40%, var(--ink));
  }
  .tape-track{
    position:relative; height:52px; overflow:hidden;
    -webkit-mask-image:linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, #000 15%, #000 85%, transparent);
    mask-image:linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, #000 15%, #000 85%, transparent);
  }
  .tape-ruler{
    position:absolute; top:0; left:50%; height:100%;
    display:flex; align-items:center;
    transition:transform .55s cubic-bezier(.22,.8,.28,1);
    white-space:nowrap;
  }
  .tape-tick{
    display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
    padding:0 34px; height:100%;
    font-family:'Space Mono', monospace;
    color:#5c5c54; font-size:13px; letter-spacing:.02em;
    transition:color .4s ease, transform .4s ease, opacity .4s ease;
    opacity:.45; transform:scale(.82);
    border-right:1px solid rgba(255,247,210,.12);
  }
  .tape-tick .tick-title{
    font-family:'Archivo', sans-serif; font-weight:700; font-size:15px; color:inherit;
  }
  .tape-tick .tick-num{font-size:10px; margin-top:3px; color:#4a4a44;}
  .tape-tick.active{
    color:var(--cream); opacity:1; transform:scale(1.14);
  }
  .tape-tick.active .tick-num{color:var(--tape);}
  .tape-tick.near{opacity:.75; transform:scale(.95); color:#a7a79c;}
  .tape-center-line{
    position:absolute; left:50%; top:6px; bottom:6px; width:2px;
    background:var(--tape); transform:translateX(-50%); z-index:5; border-radius:2px;
  }
  .tape-controls{
    display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:22px; margin-top:14px;
    font-family:'Space Mono', monospace; font-size:12px; color:var(--gray);
  }
  .tape-arrow{
    width:34px; height:34px; border-radius:50%; border:1px solid rgba(255,247,210,.3);
    display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; font-size:15px; color:var(--cream);
    transition:background .2s ease, transform .15s ease;
  }
  .tape-arrow:hover{background:rgba(255,247,210,.12); transform:translateY(-1px);}

  /* ============ WORK PAGE ============ */
  #work{background:var(--ink); color:var(--cream);}
  .work-hero{padding:70px 40px 30px;}
  .work-hero h1{font-family:'Unbounded'; font-size:clamp(30px,4.6vw,52px); font-weight:700; line-height:1.02; max-width:820px;}
  .work-hero p{margin-top:18px; max-width:480px; color:var(--cream-soft); font-size:15px; line-height:1.6;}

  /* Reusable "Maßband" tape component for inline (non-hero) use, e.g. Work filter, FAQ filter */
  .tape-section{position:relative; padding:10px 0 34px; background:var(--ink);}
  .tape-section .tape-track{height:56px;}
  .tape-section-label{
    text-align:center; font-family:'Space Mono',monospace; font-size:11px; color:#7c7c72;
    letter-spacing:.06em; margin-bottom:6px;
  }

  /* ---- Wild bento-style portfolio grid (CSS Grid, not columns) ---- */
  .work-grid{
    display:grid;
    grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill, minmax(190px,1fr));
    grid-auto-rows:190px;
    grid-auto-flow:row dense;
    gap:14px; padding:20px 40px 40px;
  }
  @media (max-width:680px){
    .work-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill, minmax(140px,1fr)); grid-auto-rows:150px;}
  }
  .work-card{
    position:relative; overflow:hidden; background:#151515; display:block;
    border-radius:3px;
    transform:rotate(var(--tilt,0deg));
    transition:transform .35s ease, box-shadow .35s ease;
  }
  .work-card:hover{transform:rotate(0deg) scale(1.015); box-shadow:0 18px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.5); z-index:5;}
  .work-card img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block; transition:transform .6s ease;}
  .work-card:hover img{transform:scale(1.06);}
  .work-card .overlay{
    position:absolute; inset:0; padding:18px;
    display:flex; flex-direction:column; justify-content:flex-end;
    background:linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(11,11,11,0) 40%, rgba(11,11,11,.92) 100%);
    opacity:0; transition:opacity .35s ease;
  }
  .work-card:hover .overlay{opacity:1;}
  .work-card .overlay .cat{font-family:'Space Mono',monospace; font-size:10.5px; color:var(--tape); margin-bottom:6px;}
  .work-card .overlay h3{font-size:17px; font-weight:700; line-height:1.15;}
  .work-card .overlay .meta{font-size:11.5px; color:var(--cream-soft); margin-top:6px;}
  .work-card.hidden{display:none;}

  /* ============ HOW-TO PAGE ============ */
  #howto{background:var(--cream); color:var(--ink);}
  .howto-hero{padding:70px 40px 20px;}
  .howto-hero h1{font-family:'Unbounded'; font-size:clamp(30px,4.6vw,50px); font-weight:700; max-width:760px; line-height:1.04;}
  .howto-hero p{margin-top:16px; max-width:480px; font-size:15px; line-height:1.6; color:#4a4a42;}

  /* ---- Zigzag bubble process ---- */
  .process{position:relative; max-width:820px; margin:60px auto 110px; padding:0 24px;}
  .process-svg{position:absolute; inset:0; width:100%; height:100%; pointer-events:none; z-index:0;}
  .process-svg path{fill:none; stroke:var(--ink); stroke-width:2; stroke-dasharray:1 10; stroke-linecap:round;}
  .process-step{
    position:relative; z-index:1; display:flex; margin-bottom:64px;
    opacity:0; transform:translateY(24px); transition:opacity .7s ease, transform .7s ease;
  }
  .process-step:last-child{margin-bottom:0;}
  .process-step.in-view{opacity:1; transform:translateY(0);}
  .process-step.left{justify-content:flex-start;}
  .process-step.right{justify-content:flex-end;}
  .process-bubble{
    position:relative; overflow:hidden;
    width:min(80%,380px); min-height:190px;
    border-radius:20px;
    background:var(--ink); color:var(--cream);
    padding:38px 40px;
    display:flex; flex-direction:column; justify-content:center;
    text-align:left;
    transition:transform .35s ease, background .35s ease;
  }
  .process-step.right .process-bubble{text-align:right;}
  .process-bubble::after{
    content:attr(data-num);
    position:absolute; top:-0.12em; right:-0.04em;
    font-family:'Unbounded',sans-serif; font-weight:800; font-size:128px; line-height:1;
    letter-spacing:-.02em;
    color:rgba(255,247,210,.07);
    z-index:0; pointer-events:none;
    transition:color .35s ease;
  }
  .process-step.right .process-bubble::after{right:auto; left:-.04em;}
  .process-num{
    position:relative; z-index:1;
    font-family:'Space Mono',monospace; font-size:11.5px; color:var(--tape);
    margin-bottom:12px; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:9px; letter-spacing:.06em;
  }
  .process-num::before{content:""; width:20px; height:1.5px; background:var(--tape); display:inline-block;}
  .process-step.right .process-num{flex-direction:row-reverse;}
  .process-bubble h3{position:relative; z-index:1; font-family:'Unbounded',sans-serif; font-size:19px; font-weight:600; margin-bottom:10px; line-height:1.3;}
  .process-bubble p{position:relative; z-index:1; font-size:13.5px; line-height:1.65; color:var(--cream-soft);}
  .process-bubble:hover{transform:translateY(-6px); background:#161616;}
  .process-bubble:hover::after{color:rgba(199,62,62,.16);}

  .faq-section{background:var(--ink); color:var(--cream); padding:20px 40px 100px;}
  .faq-header{max-width:760px; margin:0 auto 30px; text-align:center;}
  .faq-eyebrow{font-family:'Space Mono',monospace; font-size:12px; color:var(--tape); margin-bottom:10px;}
  .faq-header h2{font-family:'Unbounded'; font-size:clamp(24px,3.6vw,40px); font-weight:700;}

  .faq-grid{max-width:900px; margin:50px auto 0; display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; gap:26px 50px;}
  @media (max-width:720px){.faq-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;}}
  .faq-item{border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,247,210,.18); padding-bottom:18px; display:none;}
  .faq-item.show{display:block;}
  .faq-item summary{font-size:16px; font-weight:700; cursor:pointer; list-style:none; padding:6px 0; position:relative; padding-right:24px;}
  .faq-item summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none;}
  .faq-item summary::after{content:"+"; position:absolute; right:0; top:6px; font-size:18px; color:var(--tape); transition:transform .25s ease;}
  .faq-item[open] summary::after{transform:rotate(45deg);}
  .faq-item p{font-size:13.5px; line-height:1.65; color:var(--cream-soft); padding:8px 0 4px;}

  /* ============ ABOUT PAGE ============ */
  #about{background:var(--ink); color:var(--cream); position:relative; overflow:hidden;}
  .about-hero{
    position:relative; min-height:100vh; display:flex; align-items:center;
    padding:0 40px;
  }
  .about-blend{
    position:absolute; inset:0; z-index:1;
    background:
      radial-gradient(ellipse 60% 70% at 78% 45%, rgba(199,62,62,.18), transparent 60%),
      radial-gradient(ellipse 80% 90% at 85% 50%, rgba(255,247,210,.10), transparent 65%);
  }
  .about-mark{
    position:absolute; right:4%; bottom:0; top:auto;
    height:94%; width:auto; max-width:58vw; z-index:1;
    filter:grayscale(.12) contrast(1.06) brightness(1.03) saturate(1.05);
    -webkit-mask-image:linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0%, rgba(0,0,0,.5) 16%, #000 38%, #000 100%);
    mask-image:linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0%, rgba(0,0,0,.5) 16%, #000 38%, #000 100%);
  }
  @media (max-width:760px){.about-mark{position:relative; height:auto; width:80%; max-width:360px; margin:40px auto 0; display:block; right:auto;}}
  .about-content{position:relative; z-index:2; max-width:560px;}
  .about-content h1{font-family:'Unbounded'; font-weight:700; font-size:clamp(26px,4vw,44px); line-height:1.08; margin-bottom:22px;}
  .about-content p{font-size:15px; line-height:1.75; color:var(--cream-soft); margin-bottom:16px; max-width:460px;}
  .about-wordmark{font-family:'Unbounded'; font-weight:800; font-size:clamp(44px,9vw,130px); letter-spacing:-.01em; color:var(--cream); position:relative; z-index:2; margin-top:40px;}

  .about-values{
    display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr); gap:1px; background:rgba(255,247,210,.15);
    margin-top:0;
  }
  @media (max-width:760px){.about-values{grid-template-columns:1fr;}}
  .about-values div{background:var(--ink); padding:44px 36px;}
  .about-values h4{font-family:'Space Mono',monospace; font-size:12px; color:var(--tape); margin-bottom:12px;}
  .about-values p{font-size:14px; line-height:1.6; color:var(--cream-soft); max-width:320px;}

  /* ============ IMPRESSUM ============ */
  #impressum{background:var(--cream); color:var(--ink); padding-bottom:100px;}
  .legal-hero{padding:70px 40px 10px;}
  .legal-hero h1{font-family:'Unbounded'; font-size:clamp(26px,4vw,44px); font-weight:700;}
  .legal-body{max-width:680px; margin:40px auto 0; padding:0 24px;}
  .legal-body h2{font-size:18px; font-weight:800; margin:36px 0 12px; border-bottom:2px solid var(--ink); padding-bottom:8px;}
  .legal-body p, .legal-body li{font-size:14px; line-height:1.75; color:#2b2b26; margin-bottom:6px;}
  .legal-body .ph{background:rgba(199,62,62,.12); color:var(--tape); padding:1px 6px; border-radius:4px; font-weight:600;}
  .legal-body ul{padding-left:18px; list-style:disc; margin-bottom:10px;}

  /* ============ CONTACT ============ */
  #contact{background:var(--cream); color:var(--ink);}
  .contact-wrap{
    display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; min-height:calc(100vh - 79px);
  }
  @media (max-width:900px){.contact-wrap{grid-template-columns:1fr;}}
  .contact-left{padding:70px 50px; border-right:1px solid rgba(11,11,11,.1);}
  @media (max-width:900px){.contact-left{border-right:none; border-bottom:1px solid rgba(11,11,11,.1);}}
  .contact-left h1{font-family:'Unbounded'; font-size:clamp(24px,3.2vw,38px); font-weight:700; line-height:1.08; margin-bottom:16px; max-width:380px;}
  .contact-left > p{font-size:14.5px; line-height:1.65; color:#3d3d36; max-width:360px; margin-bottom:36px;}
  .contact-info-row{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:14px; margin-bottom:18px; font-size:14.5px;}
  .contact-info-row .ico{width:34px; height:34px; border-radius:50%; border:1px solid var(--ink); display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; font-size:15px; flex-shrink:0;}
  .socials{display:flex; gap:12px; margin:26px 0 36px;}
  .socials a{width:38px; height:38px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--ink); color:var(--cream); display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; font-size:14px; transition:background .2s ease;}
  .socials a:hover{background:var(--tape);}
  .map-frame{border-radius:14px; overflow:hidden; border:1px solid rgba(11,11,11,.15); height:220px;}
  .map-frame iframe{width:100%; height:100%; border:0; filter:grayscale(0.4) contrast(1.05);}

  .contact-right{padding:70px 50px;}
  .form-toggle{display:flex; border:1px solid var(--ink); border-radius:999px; overflow:hidden; width:fit-content; margin-bottom:40px;}
  .form-toggle button{padding:11px 22px; font-size:13.5px; font-weight:700; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:9px; transition:background .2s ease, color .2s ease;}
  .form-toggle button .ico{flex-shrink:0; opacity:.85;}
  .form-toggle button.active{background:var(--ink); color:var(--cream);}
  .contact-form{display:none;}
  .contact-form.active{display:block;}
  .form-row{margin-bottom:28px;}
  .form-row.two{display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; gap:26px;}
  label{display:block; font-family:'Space Mono',monospace; font-size:10.5px; font-weight:400; letter-spacing:.07em; margin-bottom:10px; color:#7a7a6c; text-transform:uppercase;}
  label .req{color:var(--tape);}
  input, select{
    width:100%; padding:8px 2px 11px; border:none; border-bottom:1.5px solid rgba(11,11,11,.22);
    border-radius:0; font-family:'Archivo',sans-serif; font-size:15.5px; background:transparent; color:var(--ink);
    transition:border-color .25s ease;
  }
  input::placeholder{color:#a3a396;}
  input:focus, select:focus{outline:none; border-bottom-color:var(--tape);}
  select{
    appearance:none; -webkit-appearance:none; -moz-appearance:none; cursor:pointer;
    background-image:url("data:image/svg+xml;base64,PHN2ZyB4bWxucz0iaHR0cDovL3d3dy53My5vcmcvMjAwMC9zdmciIHdpZHRoPSIxMiIgaGVpZ2h0PSI4IiB2aWV3Qm94PSIwIDAgMTIgOCI+PHBhdGggZD0iTTEgMWw1IDUgNS01IiBzdHJva2U9IiMwYjBiMGIiIHN0cm9rZS13aWR0aD0iMS40IiBmaWxsPSJub25lIiBzdHJva2UtbGluZWNhcD0icm91bmQiIHN0cm9rZS1saW5lam9pbj0icm91bmQiLz48L3N2Zz4=");
    background-repeat:no-repeat; background-position:right 2px center; background-size:11px; padding-right:22px;
  }
  textarea{
    width:100%; padding:16px 18px; border:1px solid rgba(11,11,11,.13); border-radius:16px;
    font-family:'Archivo',sans-serif; font-size:14.5px; line-height:1.5; background:var(--cream-soft); color:var(--ink);
    min-height:110px; resize:vertical; transition:border-color .25s ease, background .25s ease;
  }
  textarea::placeholder{color:#9c9c8e;}
  textarea:focus{outline:none; border-color:var(--tape); background:#fffdf5;}
  .submit-btn{
    margin-top:8px; width:100%; padding:16px; background:var(--ink); color:var(--cream);
    border-radius:999px; font-weight:700; font-size:14.5px; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px;
    transition:background .2s ease;
  }
  .submit-btn:hover{background:var(--tape);}
  .form-note{text-align:center; font-size:11.5px; color:#6b6b60; margin-top:14px;}

  /* ============ FOOTER ============ */
  .site-footer{
    padding:36px 40px; display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center;
    font-size:12px; color:#6b6b60; border-top:1px solid rgba(11,11,11,.1); flex-wrap:wrap; gap:10px;
  }
  .theme-dark .site-footer{border-top:1px solid rgba(255,247,210,.15); color:#9c9c8e;}
  .site-footer a{font-weight:600; color:inherit;}
  .site-footer a:hover{color:var(--tape);}

  ::selection{background:var(--tape); color:var(--cream);}
  :focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--tape); outline-offset:2px;}
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*{transition:none !important; animation:none !important;}}
</style>
</head>

<script>
/* ============ SHARED NAV INJECTION ============ */
const navHTML = () => `
  <div class="nav-half left"><a href="#work">Work/Portfolio</a><a href="#howto">How to</a></div>
  <a class="nav-mark" href="#home" aria-label="Zur Startseite"></a>
  <div class="nav-half right"><a href="#about">About</a><a href="#impressum">Impressum</a><a href="#contact">Contact</a></div>
  <button class="nav-burger">MENU</button>
`;
['navWork','navHowto','navAbout','navImpressum','navContact'].forEach(id=>{
  document.getElementById(id).innerHTML = navHTML();
});

/* mobile burger toggle */
document.querySelectorAll('.nav-burger').forEach(btn=>{
  btn.addEventListener('click', ()=> btn.closest('.site-nav').classList.toggle('menu-open'));
});

/* highlight current nav link */
function markCurrentNav(hash){
  document.querySelectorAll('.site-nav a, .hero-nav a').forEach(a=>{
    a.classList.toggle('current', a.getAttribute('href') === hash);
  });
}

/* ============ ROUTER ============ */
const pages = ['home','work','howto','about','impressum','contact'];
function route(){
  let hash = (location.hash || '#home').replace('#','');
  if(!pages.includes(hash)) hash = 'home';
  pages.forEach(p=>{
    document.getElementById(p).classList.toggle('active', p===hash);
  });
  markCurrentNav('#'+hash);
  window.scrollTo(0,0);
  if(hash==='howto') initProcessObserver();
}
window.addEventListener('hashchange', route);
window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', route);

/* ============ HERO JOB DATA + MASSBAND ============ */
const jobs = [
  {title:"Solden Editorial", loc:"Sölden, AT", date:"März 2026", img:"https://picsum.photos/seed/voto1/900/1100"},
  {title:"Nordlicht Campaign", loc:"Tromsø, NO", date:"Jan 2026", img:"https://picsum.photos/seed/voto2/900/1100"},
  {title:"Urban Portraits Vol. 3", loc:"Berlin, DE", date:"Nov 2025", img:"https://picsum.photos/seed/voto3/900/1100"},
  {title:"Kai Sneaker Drop", loc:"Stuttgart, DE", date:"Sep 2025", img:"https://picsum.photos/seed/voto4/900/1100"},
  {title:"Studio Still Life", loc:"Studio Stuttgart", date:"Jul 2025", img:"https://picsum.photos/seed/voto5/900/1100"},
];
/* ============ REUSABLE "MASSBAND" TAPE COMPONENT ============
   Used identically by the Hero job switcher, the Work filter and the FAQ filter. */
function createTape({ruler, prevBtn, nextBtn, counterEl, labels, onSelect, startIndex=0}){
  let active = startIndex;
  ruler.innerHTML = labels.map((l,i)=>`
    <button class="tape-tick" data-i="${i}">
      <span class="tick-title">${l}</span>
      <span class="tick-num">0${i+1}</span>
    </button>`).join('');
  const getTicks = ()=> ruler.querySelectorAll('.tape-tick');
  getTicks().forEach(el=> el.addEventListener('click', ()=> setActive(parseInt(el.dataset.i))));

  function update(){
    getTicks().forEach((el,idx)=>{
      el.classList.remove('active','near');
      if(idx===active) el.classList.add('active');
      else if(Math.abs(idx-active)===1) el.classList.add('near');
    });
    requestAnimationFrame(()=>{
      const activeEl = getTicks()[active];
      if(!activeEl) return;
      const elCenter = activeEl.offsetLeft + activeEl.offsetWidth/2;
      ruler.style.transform = `translateX(${-elCenter}px)`;
    });
    if(counterEl) counterEl.textContent = `0${active+1} // 0${labels.length}`;
    onSelect(active, labels[active]);
  }
  function setActive(i){ active = (i + labels.length) % labels.length; update(); }

  if(prevBtn) prevBtn.addEventListener('click', ()=> setActive(active-1));
  if(nextBtn) nextBtn.addEventListener('click', ()=> setActive(active+1));
  window.addEventListener('resize', ()=> update());
  setActive(startIndex);
  return {setActive, getActive:()=>active};
}

/* ---- Hero job switcher ---- */
function updateHeroVisual(activeJob){
  const j = jobs[activeJob];
  document.getElementById('jobLocation').textContent = j.loc;
  document.getElementById('jobDate').textContent = j.date;
  const main = document.getElementById('frameMain').querySelector('img');
  const left = document.getElementById('frameLeft').querySelector('img');
  const right = document.getElementById('frameRight').querySelector('img');
  main.src = j.img;
  left.src = jobs[(activeJob+jobs.length-1)%jobs.length].img;
  right.src = jobs[(activeJob+1)%jobs.length].img;
}
createTape({
  ruler: document.getElementById('tapeRuler'),
  prevBtn: document.getElementById('tapePrev'),
  nextBtn: document.getElementById('tapeNext'),
  counterEl: document.getElementById('tapeCounter'),
  labels: jobs.map(j=>j.title),
  onSelect: updateHeroVisual
});

/* ============ WORK GRID ============ */
const workItems = [
  {title:"Solden Editorial", loc:"Sölden, AT", date:"03/2026", cat:"nature", img:"https://picsum.photos/seed/w1/500/650"},
  {title:"Urban Portraits Vol.3", loc:"Berlin, DE", date:"11/2025", cat:"portraits", img:"https://picsum.photos/seed/w2/500/650"},
  {title:"Late Shift", loc:"Hamburg, DE", date:"08/2025", cat:"street", img:"https://picsum.photos/seed/w3/500/650"},
  {title:"Kai Sneaker Drop", loc:"Stuttgart, DE", date:"09/2025", cat:"products", img:"https://picsum.photos/seed/w4/500/650"},
  {title:"Marathon Momentum", loc:"München, DE", date:"05/2025", cat:"sports", img:"https://picsum.photos/seed/w5/500/650"},
  {title:"Studio Still Life", loc:"Studio Stuttgart", date:"07/2025", cat:"products", img:"https://picsum.photos/seed/w6/500/650"},
  {title:"Faces of the Fair", loc:"Leipzig, DE", date:"04/2025", cat:"portraits", img:"https://picsum.photos/seed/w7/500/650"},
  {title:"Alpine Light", loc:"Garmisch, DE", date:"02/2025", cat:"nature", img:"https://picsum.photos/seed/w8/500/650"},
  {title:"Crosswalk Series", loc:"Köln, DE", date:"12/2024", cat:"street", img:"https://picsum.photos/seed/w9/500/650"},
  {title:"Matchday", loc:"Dortmund, DE", date:"10/2024", cat:"sports", img:"https://picsum.photos/seed/w10/500/650"},
  {title:"Packshots Vol.2", loc:"Studio Stuttgart", date:"09/2024", cat:"products", img:"https://picsum.photos/seed/w11/500/650"},
  {title:"Golden Hour Portraits", loc:"Tübingen, DE", date:"07/2024", cat:"portraits", img:"https://picsum.photos/seed/w12/500/650"},
];
const workGrid = document.getElementById('workGrid');
const tilts = [-2.5, 1.5, -1, 2, -1.8, 1, 0, -2, 1.8, -1.2, 2.2, -0.8];
workGrid.innerHTML = workItems.map((w,i)=>`
  <div class="work-card" data-cat="${w.cat}" style="--tilt:${tilts[i%tilts.length]}deg;">
    <img src="${w.img}" alt="${w.title}" loading="lazy">
    <div class="overlay">
      <div class="cat">${w.cat.toUpperCase()}</div>
      <h3>${w.title}</h3>
      <div class="meta">${w.loc} — ${w.date}</div>
    </div>
  </div>
`).join('');

/* ---- Work filter: identical "Maßband" component as Hero ---- */
const workFilterLabels = ["Portraits","Street","Nature","Sports","Products"];
createTape({
  ruler: document.getElementById('workTapeRuler'),
  prevBtn: document.getElementById('workTapePrev'),
  nextBtn: document.getElementById('workTapeNext'),
  counterEl: document.getElementById('workTapeCounter'),
  labels: workFilterLabels,
  startIndex: 0,
  onSelect: (i, label)=>{
    const f = label.toLowerCase();
    document.querySelectorAll('.work-card').forEach(card=>{
      card.classList.toggle('hidden', card.dataset.cat!==f);
    });
  }
});

/* ============ HOW-TO PROCESS: alternating bubbles + connecting line ============ */
const steps = [
  {n:"01", t:"Vorgespräch", d:"Wir klären Ziel, Stil und Verwendungszweck der Bilder — telefonisch oder bei uns im Studio. So entsteht ein gemeinsames Briefing, bevor überhaupt Equipment aufgebaut wird."},
  {n:"02", t:"Shooting", d:"Am Shootingtag setzen wir das Konzept um — im Studio oder On-Location. Genug Zeit für Looks, Licht und die entscheidenden Momente."},
  {n:"03", t:"Bildauswahl", d:"Du erhältst eine kuratierte Vorauswahl in einer privaten Online-Galerie und wählst in Ruhe deine Favoriten aus."},
  {n:"04", t:"Nachbearbeitung und Lieferung", d:"Wir bearbeiten die ausgewählten Bilder in Farbe, Licht und Retusche und liefern sie in druckfertiger und Web-Auflösung."},
];
const processList = document.getElementById('processList');
steps.forEach((s,i)=>{
  const side = i % 2 === 0 ? 'left' : 'right';
  const el = document.createElement('div');
  el.className = `process-step ${side}`;
  el.innerHTML = `<div class="process-bubble" data-num="${s.n}"><span class="process-num">${s.n}</span><h3>${s.t}</h3><p>${s.d}</p></div>`;
  processList.appendChild(el);
});

function drawProcessLine(){
  const container = document.getElementById('processList');
  const svg = document.getElementById('processSvg');
  const path = document.getElementById('processPath');
  if(!container || !svg || container.offsetParent === null) return;
  const rect = container.getBoundingClientRect();
  svg.setAttribute('viewBox', `0 0 ${rect.width} ${rect.height}`);
  const bubbles = container.querySelectorAll('.process-bubble');
  const pts = Array.from(bubbles).map(b=>{
    const r = b.getBoundingClientRect();
    return {x: r.left - rect.left + r.width/2, y: r.top - rect.top + r.height/2};
  });
  if(pts.length < 2){ path.setAttribute('d',''); return; }
  let d = `M ${pts[0].x} ${pts[0].y}`;
  for(let i=0;i<pts.length-1;i++){
    const p0 = pts[i], p1 = pts[i+1];
    const midY = (p0.y + p1.y)/2;
    d += ` C ${p0.x} ${midY}, ${p1.x} ${midY}, ${p1.x} ${p1.y}`;
  }
  path.setAttribute('d', d);
}

let processObserverInit = false;
function initProcessObserver(){
  drawProcessLine();
  if(processObserverInit) return;
  processObserverInit = true;
  const obs = new IntersectionObserver((entries)=>{
    entries.forEach(e=>{ if(e.isIntersecting) e.target.classList.add('in-view'); });
  }, {threshold:0.3});
  document.querySelectorAll('.process-step').forEach(el=>obs.observe(el));
  window.addEventListener('resize', drawProcessLine);
}

/* ============ FAQ ============ */
const faqCategories = ["General","Shooting","Payment","Deliverables","Rescheduling","Rights"];
const faqData = {
  General: [
    ["Wie lange dauert ein typisches Shooting?","Je nach Umfang zwischen 1 und 4 Stunden. Größere Produktionen planen wir individuell."],
    ["Kann ich das Studio besichtigen?","Ja, nach Absprache jederzeit — schreib uns einfach über das Kontaktformular."]
  ],
  Shooting: [
    ["Kann ich eigenes Equipment mitbringen?","Klar, unser Studio ist offen für Gastequipment. Sag uns vorher Bescheid, damit wir Platz einplanen."],
    ["Bieten ihr auch Shootings außerhalb des Studios an?","Ja, On-Location-Shootings sind möglich, Anfahrt wird separat berechnet."]
  ],
  Payment: [
    ["Wie läuft die Bezahlung ab?","50% Anzahlung bei Buchung, der Rest nach Lieferung der finalen Bilder."],
    ["Welche Zahlungsarten akzeptiert ihr?","Überweisung, PayPal und auf Wunsch Rechnung für Firmenkunden."]
  ],
  Deliverables: [
    ["In welchem Format erhalte ich die Bilder?","Web-Auflösung als JPEG sowie hochauflösend als TIFF oder JPEG für den Druck."],
    ["Wie viele Bilder bekomme ich?","Abhängig vom gebuchten Paket, in der Regel 15–40 finale Bilder."]
  ],
  Rescheduling: [
    ["Kann ich meinen Termin verschieben?","Bis 48 Stunden vorher kostenlos, danach wird eine kleine Umbuchungsgebühr fällig."],
    ["Was passiert bei schlechtem Wetter (Outdoor)?","Wir verschieben kostenfrei auf einen neuen Termin oder weichen ins Studio aus."]
  ],
  Rights: [
    ["Wem gehören die Bildrechte?","Die Nutzungsrechte für den vereinbarten Zweck gehen an dich über, das Urheberrecht bleibt beim Studio."],
    ["Darf ich die Bilder in sozialen Medien posten?","Ja, mit Nennung des Studios freuen wir uns sogar darüber."]
  ],
};
const faqGrid = document.getElementById('faqGrid');

function renderFAQ(cat){
  faqGrid.innerHTML = faqData[cat].map(([q,a])=>`
    <details class="faq-item show"><summary>${q}</summary><p>${a}</p></details>
  `).join('');
}

/* ---- FAQ filter: identical "Maßband" component as Hero ---- */
createTape({
  ruler: document.getElementById('faqTapeRuler'),
  prevBtn: document.getElementById('faqTapePrev'),
  nextBtn: document.getElementById('faqTapeNext'),
  counterEl: document.getElementById('faqTapeCounter'),
  labels: faqCategories,
  onSelect: (i, label)=> renderFAQ(label)
});

/* toggle contact forms */
document.querySelectorAll('.form-toggle button').forEach(btn=>{
  btn.addEventListener('click', ()=>{
    document.querySelectorAll('.form-toggle button').forEach(b=>b.classList.remove('active'));
    btn.classList.add('active');
    document.getElementById('briefForm').classList.toggle('active', btn.dataset.form==='brief');
    document.getElementById('callForm').classList.toggle('active', btn.dataset.form==='call');
  });
});
document.querySelectorAll('.contact-form').forEach(f=>{
  f.addEventListener('submit', (e)=>{ e.preventDefault(); alert('Danke! (Demo — hier würde die Anfrage versendet werden.)'); });
});
</script>
